resources.string: Enable in system settings to support this App’s background operation with a system-bound service and a transparent window that cannot receive touches. Does not read the screen, text or notifications, tap, enter text or enable terminal device access. Can be disabled at any time. An independent App toggle controls service recovery after reboot; system auto-start and background permissions are still needed.
